package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-config/lib/config"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-config/testhelper"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-errors-problems/lib/problem"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()

	// Schema composition and generation surface.
	schema := config.ComposeSchema(
		config.AppBlockSchema(),
		config.NewBlock(testhelper.DemoBlockKey, true, map[string]any{"type": "object"}),
	).WithPortal(problem.LocalErrorPortal())
	_ = schema.Root()
	artifact, _ := schema.Marshal()
	reloaded, _ := config.SchemaFromJSON(artifact)
	_ = reloaded.Validate(map[string]any{})
	_, _ = config.GenerateSchema(config.AppBlock{})
	_, _ = config.FragmentFromType(config.AppBlock{})

	// Loader surface with every option and both YAML/env source families.
	loader := config.NewLoader(
		config.WithEnvPrefix("ATOMI_"),
		config.WithBaseSource(config.NewBytesYAMLSource("base", []byte("app:\n  landscape: base\n"))),
		config.WithOverlaySource("lapras", config.NewBytesYAMLSource("overlay", nil)),
		config.WithBaseDir("config/app"),
		config.WithLandscape("lapras"),
		config.WithEnvSource(config.NewMapEnvSource("env", map[string]string{})),
		config.WithSchema(schema),
		config.WithErrorPortal(problem.LocalErrorPortal()),
	)
	cfg, err := loader.Load(ctx)
	if cfg == nil {
		cfg = config.NewConfig(testhelper.ValidRaw())
	}
	_ = cfg.Raw()
	_ = cfg.Decode("app", new(map[string]any))
	_, _ = cfg.App()
	_, _ = config.ValidationIssues(err)
	_ = config.Issue{Path: "app", Message: "x"}.String()

	// File and process source variants.
	fileSource := config.NewFileYAMLSource("base", "config/app/settings.yaml")
	_ = fileSource.Name()
	_ = fileSource.Path()
	_, _ = fileSource.Read(ctx)
	optional := config.NewOptionalFileYAMLSource("overlay", "config/app/settings.lapras.yaml")
	_, _ = optional.Read(ctx)
	osEnv := config.NewOSEnvSource()
	_ = osEnv.Name()
	_, _ = osEnv.Environ(ctx)

	// TestHelper surface.
	_ = testhelper.BaseSource(testhelper.BaseDocument())
	_ = testhelper.OverlaySource("lapras", testhelper.OverlayDocument("lapras"))
	_ = testhelper.EnvSource(map[string]string{})
	_ = testhelper.Schema()
	_ = testhelper.DemoBlock()
	_ = testhelper.InvalidSchemaBlock()
	_ = testhelper.InvalidOverlayDocument()
	_ = testhelper.SchemaPointer
	_ = testhelper.StubConfig(testhelper.ValidRaw())
	_ = testhelper.StubApp(config.AppBlock{})
	fmt.Println(testhelper.RequireConfig, testhelper.RequireLoadError, testhelper.RequireIssue)
}
